name: remove-animations
description: Find the animations an interface does not need and remove them, then clean up what they leave behind.

interface.longDescription: Find motion an interface does not need, such as animation on keyboard actions, high-frequency surfaces, functional data and pure decoration, then remove it and clean up the leftovers without adding or retuning motion.
defaultPrompt: Remove the animations this app does not need.
This interface feels over-animated; tone down the motion.
